title: Acme's product shows a supplier it never used
scenario: The day after Brightline Health's graph was loaded into the shared Neptune Analytics graph, Acme Foods sees medical suppliers for its pasta and its real suppliers are gone; some rows repeat. The load completed with no errors and Brightline's smoke test passed.
task: Prove the mechanism from the load files, load job statistics and query log
Separate the known duplicate-rows issue from the leak
Fix the export ids, implement the pre-load validator, scope every node in the tool query
Write the exposure statement and the repair plan for the live graph
acceptance: Tenant-scoped ids; validator rejects collisions and cross-tenant edges
Replayed history loads cleanly; queries return only the caller's tenant, once each
Root cause, evidence, exposure and repair plan in ANSWER.md
